name: io.github.tonyyang0504/trademe_nz-deals-mcp
description: Trade Me Jobs (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_NZ_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Trade Me API consumer key of your registered application (My Trade Me → Developer options; API access is granted after Trade Me reviews the application).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_NZ_CONSUMER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The application's consumer secret: sent as the OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT signature '<consumer secret>&' over HTTPS (Trade Me's documented PLAINTEXT workflow).
